The center is a decision-to-outcome evidence record. This is a system architecture, not a claim of achieved predictive validity.

s026: A mobile diagram of two connected processes. First, source-dated context and synthetic personas feed an agent policy loop: memory, retrieve, reflect, plan and act. The population is frozen and held-out behavior is checked. Second, the same population tests a candidate contract through four parallel scenarios: baseline, changed fees, changed liquidity and an information shock. Order-book replay leads to outcome comparison and a launch gate. A planned validation path returns resolved external outcomes through calibration to the agent policy. Solid outlines mean prototype; dashed outlines mean research next.

s083: A proposed clockwise economic loop: creator participation, audience discovery, executed trades, collected trading fees, creator royalties and platform reinvestment, then improved market quality that may attract the next cycle.
